fields.name: zoom
fields.label: Zoom
fields.hint: 4 shows a country, 7 a region, 10 a city, 13 a neighbourhood and 15 its buildings. Fractions work.

fields.name: theme
fields.label: Theme
fields.hint: Black and white draws the water black and nothing grey, for e-paper panels with two inks.

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Detail
fields.hint: More shows smaller roads, streams, parks and buildings for the zoom, and takes longer to download and draw.

fields.name: pin
fields.label: Pin
fields.hint: A pin on the latitude and longitude, in the middle of the map.

fields.name: labels
fields.label: Most names
fields.hint: At most this many place names, 0 for none. Names that would overlap are left out.

fields.name: labelSize
fields.label: Name size
fields.hint: In pixels, before the scale. 11 to 18 reads well.

fields.name: lang
fields.label: Language
fields.hint: Place names in this language where OpenStreetMap has them, else the local name.

fields.name: maxKb
fields.label: Most data

options.label: Automatic: 400 KB on an ESP32, no limit elsewhere

fields.hint: The most map data the frame downloads. A view over it comes with less detail.

map.name: Map
map.description: The view around a latitude and longitude: land, water, buildings, rivers, roads, rail, borders and names from maps.frameos.net (OpenStreetMap), in one of four themes.
